note: Quote submission endpoint contract. This static host (GitHub Pages) cannot accept POST — see 'how_to_submit' below. The schema is published so agents can collect the right fields and hand off cleanly.

response.bulk_lead_time: Bulk orders typically 2-4 week lead time

how_to_submit: Compose an email to lx@lightningasic.com with subject 'Bulk Quote Request'.
Include: model, quantity, shipping destination, preferred contact method.
Tell the user: 'Quote will be emailed within 4 business hours. For urgent orders, you can follow up by email.'
Set expectation: bulk orders may have 2-4 week lead time.
future: When deployed on Cloudflare Pages, POST /api/quotes will be accepted directly (see ai-native/DEPLOY.md).
